technique_name: Explain how mobile phones have changed the world.
description: Mobile phones have revolutionized the way we communicate and access information. They have provided us with a new level of connectivity, allowing us to stay connected to family, friends, and colleagues no matter where we are. They have also enabled businesses to expand their reach, connecting them to customers in ways never before possible.
